app.developerRequired: Enable developer mode to use this demo tool.
app.developerDisabled: Developer mode is disabled. Enable it and try again.
app.clearChatDescription: This clears the conversation for all browsers and starts a new chat. Banking data, audit logs and run records are preserved. Finish pending operations before clearing.
app.chatResetBlocked: The conversation changed or has unfinished work. Finish pending operations, refresh and try again.
app.chatResetFailed: The conversation could not be cleared. Refresh and try again.
app.assistantDescription: Your everyday banking, in one conversation.
transport.failed: The request could not be completed. Reload the conversation to check its status.
transport.randomUnavailable: This browser cannot create a request ID. Use a current browser and try again.
